data.name: Azeeyah
data.gender_notes: Azeeyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who shines, glows and radiates like a flower. The name Azeeyah carries the meaning “Radiant, shining one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Azeeyah usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of inner beauty, radiance and grace
data.etymology: Azeeyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant, shining one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azeeyah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: عزيه
in_arabic.meaning: عزيه تعني الشخصية القوية والمحترمة في المجتمع
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عزيه مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع ز ي' والذي يعني الرفعة والتمكين، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن مكانة المرأة في المجتمع. يشير الاسم إلى الشخصية القوية والمحترمة في المجتمع، والتي تتمتع بمكانة عالية ومرموقة.

in_urdu.name: عزیہ
in_urdu.meaning: عزیہ کا مطلب ہے مضبوط اور قابل احترام شخصیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزیہ نام عربی جڑ 'ع ز ي' سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے رفعت اور تائید۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں عورت کی معاشرے میں منزلت کے حوالے سے آیا ہے۔ یہ نام مضبوط اور قابل احترام شخصیت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے، جس کی معاشرے میں اعلیٰ منزلت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अज़ीया
in_hindi.meaning: अज़ीया का अर्थ है मजबूत और सम्मानित व्यक्तित्व
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़ीया नाम अरबी मूल 'ع ز ي' से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है ऊंचाई और समर्थन। यह नाम कुरआन में समाज में महिला की स्थिति के बारे में चर्चा में आया है। यह नाम मजबूत और सम्मानित व्यक्तित्व को दर्शाता है, जिसकी समाज में उच्च स्थिति है।

in_pashto.name: عزیه
in_pashto.meaning: عزیه د قوي او درنخوي شخصیت معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د عزیه نوم د عربی جڑ 'ع ز ي' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چی د لوړتوب او ملاتړ معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د قران په کریم کې د ښځې د مقام په اړه راغلی دی. دا نوم د قوي او درنخوي شخصیت ښودنه کوي، چی په ټولنه کې یې لوړ مقام دی.

in_english.name: Azeeyah
in_english.meaning: Azeeyah means strong and respected personality in society
in_english.long_meaning: The name Azeeyah is derived from the Arabic root 'ع ز ي' (ʿ-z-y), which signifies elevation and empowerment. It is mentioned in the Quran in the context of a woman's status in society. Azeeyah represents a strong and respected personality, holding a high and esteemed position in the community. The name reflects qualities of dignity, honor, and leadership.

This meaning is significant in Islamic culture, as it represents the concept of beauty and radiance, both in the physical and spiritual sense. The name can be a source of inspiration and pride for those bearing it, as it signifies the idea of excellence and brightness, not only in one's actions but also in their character.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, the name "Azeeyah" is believed to symbolize the inner radiance and light that every human being possesses, as reflected in the Quranic verse "Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth." The name can be a reminder to strive for spiritual growth and illumination, as outlined in Islamic teachings, and to let one's inner light shine brightly, reflecting the divine wisdom and grace bestowed upon us by Allah. It is a name that encourages one to be a beacon of guidance and hope for others, and a testimony to the transformative power of spiritual growth and self-improvement.
